`everything_plugin.h` is copied unmodified from the official Everything 1.5
Plugin SDK published by voidtools:

- Download: https://www.voidtools.com/Everything-1.5-Plugin-SDK.zip
- Documentation: https://www.voidtools.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=16535
- Reference plugins: https://github.com/voidtools/http_server ,
  https://github.com/voidtools/etp_server

The plugin in `everything_plugin/` only uses the message constants,
`EVERYTHING_PLUGIN_API` and `everything_plugin_get_proc_address_t` from it.
